name: Case law: Austria, Oberster Gerichtshof (OGH)
label: Austria case law (Oberster Gerichtshof (OGH))
coverage: 145586 decision texts (Entscheidungstexte) from RIS, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 5318 citations of the B-VG and the DSG linked to austria-law.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. Only full decision texts are taken, not the Rechtssätze (headnote summaries).
